_doc: Throne room (Rev 4-5). Geometry comes from res://art/throne/layout.json (art/build_throne_scene.py); this file holds content.

title.text:
The throne room of heaven
Revelation 4-5

hint: E: kneel and worship    Esc: menu

kneel.text:
Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty,
which was, and is, and is to come.
Revelation 4:8

worship.text:
The four and twenty elders fall down before him... and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power.  Rev 4:10-11

creature_text.lion: And the first beast was like a lion...  and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy.  Rev 4:7-8
creature_text.ox: ...and the second beast like a calf...  each had six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within.  Rev 4:7-8
creature_text.man: ...and the third beast had a face as a man...  full of eyes before and behind.  Rev 4:6-7
creature_text.eagle: ...and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.  Rev 4:7

zone_text.lamb: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne... stood a Lamb as it had been slain.  Rev 5:6
zone_text.lamps: There were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne... and out of the throne proceeded lightnings.  Rev 4:5
zone_text.elders: Round about the throne were four and twenty seats... elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had crowns of gold.  Rev 4:4
zone_text.sea: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal.  Rev 4:6
zone_text.throne: He that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, like an emerald.  Rev 4:3
